blocks.text: 今天我们发布 FLUX 3 Image Klein，这是一个 5.6B 参数的开源权重模型，用于文本到图像生成、图像编辑和多参考生成，最多支持 10 张参考图像。它与完整的 FLUX 3 Image 模型共享核心能力：原生 4K 生成、像素级精确编辑，以及控制元素放置位置或将编辑限制在指定区域的边界框。

blocks.text: FLUX 3 Image Klein 建立在 FLUX 3 跨图像、视频和音频的共享学习成果之上。图像贡献空间细节，视频增加运动和物理动态，音频提供有关事件和交互的信息。这些信号共同帮助模型生成贴近真实世界的图像。

blocks.text: 在内部评估中，FLUX 3 Image Klein 在文本到图像、多参考生成和图像编辑方面排名第一，领先于更大的开源权重模型。在对比中，它的评分也高于闭源模型 Ideogram V4.5 和 FLUX.2 [pro]。它以 5.6B 参数成为对比中最小的开源模型，而 Qwen-Image 2.1 为 7B，Krea 2 为 12.9B。与 FLUX.2 [klein] 9B 相比，它在文本到图像上提升 91 Elo，在图像编辑上提升 70 Elo，同时参数减少 38%。

blocks.text: FLUX 3 Image Klein 还针对消费级 GPU 进行了优化。更少的参数使其便于本地运行，也更便宜地适配，而有数据主权或本地部署要求的团队可以在自己的基础设施上评估和适配该模型。这对于设备端图像编辑也至关重要，让消费者可以直接在他们常用的笔记本电脑上编辑图像。生成器权重在 BF16 下需要 11.2 GB，在 FP8 下需要 5.6 GB。借助 INT8 版本，FLUX 3 Image Klein 可通过 ComfyUI 或 Diffusers 在显存低至 8GB 的 NVIDIA GeForce RTX GPU 上运行，将 FLUX.2 [klein] 开创的能力扩展到更小的硬件上。使用蒸馏模型和 INT8 版本，它通过 ComfyUI 在 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 上约 4 秒生成一张 1MP 图像，在 RTX 4070 上不到 9 秒。

blocks.text: 安全

为了让 AI 技术既开放又安全，我们在模型开发生命周期中实施了多重保障措施以防止滥用。这些措施包括在预训练期间使用数据集过滤器以限制接触有害内容，以及在训练后阶段进行针对性微调以抑制有害行为，使诱导有害内容变得越来越困难。在发布之前，FLUX 3 Image Klein 检查点经过了内部严格的红队测试，并由我们的外部安全合作伙伴 Cinder 评估，结果显示其漏洞显著少于其他流行的开放权重模型。有关我们安全方法的更多信息，请见此处。

blocks.text: Today we are releasing FLUX 3 Image Klein, a 5.6B parameter open weights model for text-to-image generation, image editing and multi-reference generation with up to 10 reference images. It shares core capabilities with the full FLUX 3 Image model: native 4K generation, pixel-perfect editing, and bounding boxes that control where elements are placed or confine edits to a defined area.

inlines.text: Today we are releasing FLUX 3 Image Klein, a 5.6B parameter open weights model for text-to-image generation, image editing and multi-reference generation with up to 10 reference images. It shares core capabilities with the full FLUX 3 Image model: native 4K generation, pixel-perfect editing, and bounding boxes that control where elements are placed or confine edits to a defined area.

blocks.text: FLUX 3 Image Klein builds on FLUX 3's shared learnings across images, video and audio. Images contribute spatial detail, video adds motion and physical dynamics, and audio provides information about events and interactions. Together, these signals help the model generate images that feel grounded in the real world.

blocks.text: In internal evaluations, FLUX 3 Image Klein ranks first in text-to-image, multi-reference generation and image editing, ahead of larger open weights models. It also rates above the closed models in the comparison, Ideogram V4.5 and FLUX.2 [pro]. At 5.6B parameters, it is the smallest open model in the comparison, against 7B for Qwen-Image 2.1 and 12.9B for Krea 2. Compared with FLUX.2 [klein] 9B, it gains 91 Elo in text-to-image and 70 in image editing, with 38% fewer parameters.

blocks.text: FLUX 3 Image Klein was also optimized for consumer GPUs. Fewer parameters make it practical to run locally and cheaper to adapt, and teams with data sovereignty or local deployment requirements can evaluate and adapt the model on their own infrastructure. This is also key for on-device image editing, allowing consumers to edit images directly on their favorite laptops. The generator weights require 11.2 GB in BF16 and 5.6 GB in FP8. With the INT8 build, FLUX 3 Image Klein runs on NVIDIA GeForce RTX GPUs with as little as 8GB of VRAM, through ComfyUI or Diffusers, extending what FLUX.2 [klein] started to even smaller hardware. With the distilled model and the INT8 build, it generates a 1MP image in about 4 seconds on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 and under 9 seconds on an RTX 4070 through ComfyUI.

blocks.text: Safety

In an effort to make AI technology both open and safe, we implement multiple safeguards throughout the model development lifecycle to combat misuse. These include dataset filters during pre-training to limit exposure to harmful content, and targeted fine-tuning during post-training to suppress harmful behaviors, making it progressively harder to elicit harmful content. Ahead of the release, the FLUX 3 Image Klein checkpoints were rigorously red teamed internally and evaluated by our external safety partner Cinder, demonstrating substantially fewer vulnerabilities than other popular open weights models. More on our safety methodology is available here.
